SITE: Pinduoduo.
1. Navigate to https://mobile.yangkeduo.com/search_result.html?search_key=%E6%B0%AE%E5%8C%96%E9%95%93%E5%85%85%E7%94%B5%E5%99%A8%2065W . Read window.rawData.stores.store.data.ssrListData.list via javascript_tool (fields goodsID, goodsName, priceInfo, pricePrefixInfo, salesTip, tagList texts), in chunks.
2. Pick the 3 listings that best match the description (65W GaN charger; skip 100W/140W-only, cables-only).
3. For each of the 3: navigate to https://mobile.yangkeduo.com/goods.html?goods_id=<id>; read shop name, marks, guarantees, spec block from document.body.innerText (skip the group-buy list of buyer names). Click 发起拼单 to open the variant picker, select the variant that matches 65W (and EU plug if any), read the 券后/券前 prices of that variant and list all variant names. Close it by navigating away (do not confirm).
4. For each of the 3: navigate to https://mobile.yangkeduo.com/goods_comments.html?goods_id=<id>, read the total count, tag counts, and the first ~15 reviews; scroll once for more if complaints are not visible.
